verdict.rationale: The firm's own stated offices are all in India (Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi & NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai), and its practice pages are scoped to the India jurisdiction. Membership in the wider CMS organisation is a network affiliation, not the firm's own multi-country offices or qualified practices. That is adjacent at best, since expanding abroad would still mean engaging another CMS member firm. No evidence shows the firm itself holds offices or qualifications outside India.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
